    How to play

    Every game begins in the normal chess starting position. When a piece captures, it inherits the captured piece’s movement abilities, including any that piece had already gained. Duplicate movement abilities are added only once.

    Pick a piece and then its destination. You can also drag a piece. Use the arrow keys to navigate the board and Enter to select a square.

    Small piece icons above a piece show its extra movement abilities. Only knight movement can jump over pieces. The king never gains abilities, and check and checkmate still apply.

    All other chess rules apply. Only original pawns can double-step, capture en passant, or promote. Inherited pawn movement is a forward step or a diagonal capture in the moving side’s direction. Castling is still only for kings and original rooks. Promoting a pawn keeps its inherited abilities.

    Play the bot or share a board with a friend. Each game is independent. Games are not saved, so reloading starts fresh.
